verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single docs line saying Elasticsearch combines full-text and vector search with structured filters and aggregations in one engine. That implies facet-style counts are possible, but nothing shows how faceted navigation is actually built. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of facet counts across categories, range buckets and attribute facets returned from a single query, filter-aware live count updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
